Ensure device fingerprints are generated using the Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle.digest) rather than custom hashing
Add 'last used' timestamp to trust records and invalidate tokens not used within 14 days (rather than 30-day flat expiry)
Add unit tests verifying: tokens are stored hashed, rate limiting blocks rapid verification attempts, rotated tokens remain valid, and inactive tokens expire
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: Trust tokens stored as plaintext hex in localStorage. 30-day tokens can be replayed indefinitely once stolen.

userStories.title: Reduce admin cache TTL and add re-verification for sensitive operations
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need shorter admin data cache TTL and re-verification on sensitive operations so that stale permissions cannot be exploited after role changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Update src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx ADMIN_CACHE_TTL from 30 minutes to 10 minutes (line 28)

Normalize error messages in auth flows to generic messages (e.g., 'Authentication failed') to prevent user enumeration - remove distinction between 'not admin' vs 'not authenticated'

userStories.notes: HIGH: 30-min cache means compromised admin roles stay valid too long. Silent failures in sign-out leave server sessions alive.

userStories.title: Fix secure cache encryption key derivation weakness
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the secure cache to use proper key derivation so that the AES-GCM encryption protecting cached admin data is resistant to key recovery attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Update src/lib/secure-cache.ts to use PBKDF2 with at least 100,000 iterations for key derivation instead of the current simple userId:salt concatenation (lines 61-80)
Initialize the salt synchronously on app startup to prevent the race condition where two simultaneous getOrCreateSalt() calls generate different salts (lines 24-44)
Fix the fallback salt generation (lines 38-43) to be consistent with sessionStorage salt so decryption doesn't fail
Add a cache version marker so that if the key derivation changes, old cached data is gracefully cleared rather than causing decryption errors
Add unit tests verifying: PBKDF2 key derivation produces consistent keys, wrong userId cannot decrypt data, salt initialization is atomic, and cache version migration works
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: Key derivation from userId:salt with no stretching is weak. Salt race condition can cause decryption failures.

userStories.title: Fix Three.js memory leaks and optimize particle system performance

Add explicit .dispose() calls for all Three.js geometries, materials, and textures in the component cleanup/unmount function
Verify the optimization by measuring: before/after garbage collection frequency, CPU usage on mid-range device (throttle in DevTools), and steady-state memory after 60 seconds
Ensure visual appearance of the orb and particle connections is unchanged after optimization
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: Creates 9,000-72,000 temporary objects per second causing GC stutters. O(n^2) connection logic burns CPU on mid-range devices.
